limitations.note: The patch fixed the combinational feedback in `q` but made `data` reflect the newly rotated state instead of registering the pre-rotation bit, advancing the output sequence by one clock.
The test treated the reset value as the first sequence bit and expected the first post-reset rising edge to emit the second bit, so it passed the one-clock phase error.
The search surfaced a registered-output timing precedent, but the agent did not read it before replacing the output block with a direct assignment.
